patterns.name: Payroll AD Lists automation
patterns.finding: One DocID per payroll component. Inputs employee, task code, amount, Add, Save. Currently does not explicitly fill Station/Machine/Expense dimension fields.

patterns.name: Beras selisih preparation
patterns.finding: prepareBerasAutomationData filters only componentKey=beras and overrides venusAmount/inputAmount to shortfall amount.

patterns.name: Charge job dimension parsing
patterns.finding: parseChargeJob extracts task/station/machine/expense. Expense code supports C/L/M/O/V mapping and LABOUR fallback.

patterns.name: Payroll run endpoint
patterns.finding: /api/payroll/beras/run prepares beras data then spawns payroll-runner.js with current_payroll_beras_data.json and component-key=beras.

dependencies: Millware PR_ADTRANS and PR_ADTRANSLN comparison data

integration_points.role: Prepare beras selisih payload with charge job and correct component mapping.
Fill Monthly Allowance/Deduction account dimensions and validate before Add.
Expose and preview beras selisih automation using the monthly allowance runner.

conflict_areas: Relevant backend, frontend, and automation files already have uncommitted changes.
Beras AD code is inconsistent between config AL0012 and discovered/current automation AL0011.
Payroll templates may be generated/temporary in parallel worker files; avoid editing generated _temp_engine_* or testing_data worker output.
Existing /api/payroll/automation/run response path appears to mix SSE setup and res.json; avoid broad refactor unless required for beras.
constraints: Do not overwrite pre-existing WIP changes.
Prefer existing payroll-runner and account-dimension helper patterns.
Add tests for payload transformation and charge job/dimension handling before running live automation.
Use dry-run/smoke validation before any real Millware input.
